title: hybrid.rs: MeshPrefix::contains() panics on invalid prefix_len >= 136
description: Line 162: No validation that prefix_len <= 128. When prefix_len >= 136, full_bytes = prefix_len / 8 >= 17, and addr[..full_bytes] panics with out-of-bounds access (addr is only 16 bytes). Attacker controlling add_mesh_prefix() can crash the node on next routing decision. Fix: validate prefix_len <= 128 in MeshPrefix::new() or add_mesh_prefix().
close_reason: Fixed: Added prefix_len validation in MeshPrefix::new() that clamps values > 128 to 128, preventing out-of-bounds panic in contains(). Added regression test.
